visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit studio, a muscular male performer with black hair stands against a plain white background. He is wearing a black mesh sleeveless crop top and fitted black trousers. He holds and vigorously plays a blue and black electric guitar. His facial expressions are intense, often looking directly at the lens or closing his eyes. His fingers move rapidly across the guitar's fretboard. (2) The camera moves into a close-up of his face as he appears to sing, his mouth moving in sync with the unheard rhythm. He shakes his head, causing his hair to move dynamically. The lighting highlights the definition of his arm muscles and abdominal area through the mesh fabric. The guitar's metallic strings and glossy finish are clearly visible as he strums with a black pick. (3) The shots alternate between medium shots of his upper body and full-body shots where he assumes a wide stance. He leans back, tilting the guitar upward. Quick cuts show different angles, including a side view where his profile and ear monitor are visible. The background remains a consistent, featureless bright space, providing high contrast to his dark attire and hair. (4) The performer's movements become more erratic and energetic, reflecting a climax in his performance. He kneels down on one leg while continuing to shred the guitar. In one shot, he is seen from behind, showcasing the muscular detail of his back through the wide straps of the mesh top. He then stands and raises the guitar high above his head. (5) In the final sequence, the performer slams the blue electric guitar onto the floor with significant force, causing it to break apart. He then stands still, looking away. The screen quickly cuts to black with white centered text appearing. The text indicates it is an AI production. A small watermark logo is consistently present in the bottom right corner throughout.
